readerCopy.body: You may be spending all your force on a fight you already know how to have. Mars square the South Node can make the old reaction immediate: push harder, take over, cut someone off, prove the point, or turn frustration into a contest. The conflict may be real, but the response can still be automatic. Notice what keeps getting your energy because it is familiar territory. Winning another round is not useful if it leaves the larger pattern exactly where it was.
